heard: Uthay, son of Omnihood, stands tall Son of Omri in the ancient hall From the line of Emery he came Son of Bani-Bear in the name Roots in Judah, deep and true, part of Paris' family tree. In Jerusalem they lived with care, from the days of old to now. Next to Jericho the men built Zach, your son of Emory, stood
